expectedResults: Output begins only after Play; each event produces the specified ramped or stopped state without automatic restart, and the UI reports actual host state.
objective: Verify that explicit iPhone Play drives the shared renderer through the iPhone AVFoundation host and that displayed lifecycle state follows actual host state.
steps: From stopped state, select a supported tone and activate Play; exercise stop, selection change, pitch, timbre, level, interruption, route loss, and engine-start failure.
title: iPhone audible output host integration
